## Breaking changes

- Removes `go-vet` and `gocyclo`. `gopls-check` already runs go vet's analyzers, and revive's `cognitive-complexity` caps complexity at the same threshold. Drop both ids from your config.
- `markdown-length` limits files by size instead of lines. The default is 20 KB, roughly 5k tokens; configure it with `--max-kb`. `--max-lines` no longer applies to this hook.

## Changes

- `markdown-length` errors explain why the file failed and how to fix it.
- `markdown-width` honors suppression comments: `<!-- bestprek-disable-line markdown-width -->` and `<!-- bestprek-disable markdown-width -->` / `<!-- bestprek-enable markdown-width -->` blocks, with an optional ` -- reason`.
